SIKA® VISCOCRETE® PC HRF-1: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1, March 2017, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sika_viscocrete_pchrf-1.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2017, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 is a new generation, powerful, superplastisizing concrete admixture for demanding concrete applications.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 is suitable for the production of concrete mixes which require high workability, high early strength, high water reduction and off-shutter finish characteristics. It is ideally suited for use in:
    - Precast concrete.
    - Post tensioned applications.
    - High early strength applications.
    - High strength concrete.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: HIGH RANGE WATER REDUCER - HWR
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for High Range Water Reducer (HWR).
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 has the following characteristics and advantages:
    - Very high water reduction can be used to achieve durability, high early and late-age strenghts, improved shrinkage and creep behaviour, lower cement contents and super-workable concrete mixes.
    - The neutral-set characteristics provide quicker setting and finishing times, high early strenghts and early stripping and demoulding of pre-cast products.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (March 2017, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2017, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Product information.
    | Packaging | 10-Litre pail, 205-litre drum or bulk delivery. |
    | Appearance / Colour | Light-brown liquid. |
    | Shelf life | At least one (1) year if stored in accordance with the recommendations given in 'Storage' below. |
    | Storage conditions | Store at temperatures between 5oC and 35oC in unopened, original containers, protected from direct sunlight and frost. |
    | Total Chloride Ion Content | No added chlorides. |
4.3 Technical information.
    | Specific Advice | Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 is added to the initial batch water. For optimum utilisation of the high water reduction we recommend thorough mixing at minimum wet-mixing time of 60 seconds per cubic metre. The addition of the remaining guaging water, to fine tune concrete consistency, should only be started after 2/3rds of the wet mixing time, to avoid surplus water in the concrete. Sika recommend Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 be restricted for use in site-batched concrete or for short travel times, because of the early loss of workability. |
4.4 Application information.
    - Sika Plastiment Series
    - Sika Rapid
    - Sika Ferrogard 901
    - Sika Fume
    - Sika ViscoFlow
    - Sika Retarder All admixtures must be added separately. Trial mixes are necessary to confirm plastic and hardened concrete properties.
    - Do not add to dry cement.
    - Trial mixes are necessary to ensure compliance with the required/specified plastic and hardened concrete properties.
    | Recommended Dosage | Typical dose rates range from 200-1000ml per 100kg of total cementitious material. |
    | Compatibility | Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 can be used in conjunction with the following Sika products: |
    | Restrictions | Do not use with naphthalene-based concrete admixtures. |

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (March 2017, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Sika Retarder All admixtures must be added separately. Trial mixes are necessary to confirm plastic and hardened concrete properties.
    - Trial mixes are necessary to ensure compliance with the required/specified plastic and hardened concrete properties.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1, March 2017, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sika_viscocrete_pchrf-1.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF1, version 23/09/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sds-sika-viscocretepchrf1.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Material Safety Data Sheet containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions.
    - Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product
    - Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
